---
title: "Кладбища"
listing:
  - id: grid-view
    contents: "../cemeteries/"
    type: grid
    grid-columns: 4
    fields: [image, title, subtitle, status, area, tomb-dating, tomb-amount, catalog]
    sort-ui: [title, status, area, tomb-dating, tomb-amount]
    filter-ui: [title, subtitle, status]    
    field-display-names:
      tomb-dating: "Датировка"
      status: "Статус"
      area: "Площадь"
      tomb-amount: "Памятников"
      catalog: "Каталог"
  - id: table-view
    contents: "../cemeteries/"
    type: table
    table-striped: true
    table-hover: true
    fields: [code, title, country, status, tomb-dating, tomb-amount, catalog]
    sort-ui: [code, title, country, status, tomb-dating, tomb-amount, catalog]
    filter-ui: [code, title, country, status]    
    field-links: [code]
    field-display-names:
      code: "Код"
      title: "Место"
      country: "Cтрана"
      tomb-dating: "Датировка"
      status: "Статус"
      tomb-amount: "Памятников"
      catalog: "Каталог"
include-in-header:
  - text: |
      <style>
          .reduced-intervals p {
            margin-bottom: 0.3em;
          }

         .quarto-grid-item .card-title {
            font-weight: bold;
          }

         .quarto-grid-item .card-other-values tr>td:first-of-type {
            padding-left: 0px;
            vertical-align: middle;
          }
 
         .g-col-1 {
            border-radius: var(--bs-border-radius);  
            transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
          }

         .g-col-1:hover {
            transform: translateY(0px);
            box-shadow: 0px 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
          }

          table.card-other-values {
              line-height: 1.8em;
              top-margin: 1em;
              bottom-margin: 0;
          }
      
          table.card-other-values tbody td:first-child {
              text-align: left;
              font-weight: normal !important;
              color: #828282;
          }
      
          table.card-other-values tbody td:last-child {
               text-align: right;
          }
      
          .quarto-grid-item .custom-btn {
               --bs-btn-padding-y: 0.2rem; 
               --bs-btn-padding-x: 0.5rem; 
               --bs-btn-font-size: 0.8rem;
          }
      
          .quarto-listing-table .custom-btn {
               --bs-btn-padding-y: 0.25rem; 
               --bs-btn-padding-x: 0.5rem; 
               --bs-btn-font-size: 0.875rem;
          }
      
          .quarto-listing-table tr {
              vertical-align: middle;
              text-align: center;
          }

          .listing-title { 
              font-weight: bold; 
          }

          .quarto-listing-table th:nth-child(2),
          .quarto-listing-table td:nth-child(2) {
              text-align: left;
          }

          .quarto-listing-table th:nth-child(7),
          .quarto-listing-table td:nth-child(7) {
              text-align: left;
          }

      </style>
---

:::: {.panel-tabset .reduced-intervals}
